# CUTANEOUS CANDIDIASIS

Cutaneous candidiasis is a superficial fungal infection of the epidermis. Presents with red, erythematous patches, often in areas where skin contacts skin, including axillae, groin, and abdominal folds. Keep affected areas dry and clean.

## Treatment Duration

Treat for 4 weeks.
